law_name: Law on Personal Data Protection (Law No. 99-Z)
jurisdiction: National Center for Personal Data Protection
applies_to: State bodies, companies & sole proprietors in Belarus, foreign organizations processing data there
key_requirements: Consent as main basis, data subject rights, cross-border transfer limits, operator security duties
retention_period: Art. 4: storage in identifiable form no longer than the declared processing purposes require; specific periods set by legislation or by operator
enforcement_authority: National Center for Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Belarus
penalties_range: Up to 200 base units administrative fine (Art. 23.7 Code of Administrative Offences); criminal liability also possible
exemptions: Household use; national security & defence; operational-investigative work
notes: Regulator set up by Presidential Decree No. 422 (28 Oct 2021) after the law took effect
